p, k = map(int, input().split())

MOD = 1000000007

def find_parent(x, parent_array):
    if parent_array[x] == x:
        return x
    parent_array[x] = find_parent(parent_array[x], parent_array)
    return parent_array[x]

def union_sets(a, b, parent_array, total_components):
    a = find_parent(a, parent_array)
    b = find_parent(b, parent_array)
    if a == b:
        return total_components
    total_components -= 1
    parent_array[b] = a
    return total_components

def mod_pow(base, e):
    result = 1
    base = base % MOD
    while e > 0:
        if e & 1:
            result = (result * base) % MOD
        base = (base * base) % MOD
        e >>= 1
    return result

if k == 0:
    print(mod_pow(p, p - 1))
else:
    total_components = p - (1 if k > 1 else 0)
    parent_array = [i for i in range(p)]
    for i in range(1, p):
        total_components = union_sets(i, (i * k) % p, parent_array, total_components)
    print(mod_pow(p, total_components))
